about_the_game:
Get Ready to Rock it Up in an All New Adventure!

Explore a whimsical world of rock-folk, where you play as Pebble! A rock golem navigating the world beyond what they know, seeking to restore the tower that once stood tall.

Collect and Throw Rocks!

Resting in different biomes of the world are small rocks holding unique elemental magic and personalities within them! Find these rock pals and add them to your team as you explore this mystical world.

Your rock pals also hold another curious power; the power of fusion! Discover each fusion as you unlock more rocks!

Solve Puzzles!

Along your journey you will run into various puzzles that test your skill. Use the abilities of your small rock pals to tackle these challenges and progress!

Defeat Bosses!

Each biome is protected by its own guardian, the overseer of all that goes on in its territory. But what's this?! Something doesn't seem right... Defeat the guardians to calm them down and earn your way to the next biome.

And Restore the Magical Balance!

The world, once abundant in magic, has now started to wilt due to corruption. Push back the corruption as you make your way to find out where it's coming from!

name: Terramystra

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 +
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 +
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

short_description: Terramystra is a 3D fantasy puzzle-adventure game, where you play as a magical rock golem called Pebble and collect smaller magical rocks to solve puzzles, defeat guardian bosses, and restore the magical balance of the world! Collect rocks for your party and throw them to uncover what lies ahead.
